top: Tom Holland plays Spider-Man on the big screen. But some of his best Spider-Man moments never made it into a movie.
comment: He has visited children's hospitals in the full suit since 2016, doing flips for the kids. In 2019 he came back with Zendaya and Jake Gyllenhaal 🕷️
